purpose: Static economic calendar event definitions for MacroAnalysis UI/API. This file is an allowlist for tracked calendar events and a shared explanation metadata source for backend and frontend consumers.

do: 경제 일정의 의미를 쉬운 문장으로 설명한다.
시장 해석에 필요한 맥락을 짧고 분명하게 제공한다.
AI 호출 없이 정적으로 사용할 수 있게 유지한다.
avoid: 초보자, 입문자 등 사용자를 낮춰 보일 수 있는 표현

field_definitions.key: Stable calendar event key used by collector, DB upsert, and API responses.
field_definitions.category: Logical grouping used by the calendar domain.
field_definitions.provider: Primary upstream source used for date collection.
field_definitions.description: Plain-language explanation of what the event is.
field_definitions.short_label: Compact UI label for badges, cards, and tooltips.
field_definitions.market_role: Why the market watches this event.
field_definitions.higher_meaning: Common interpretation when the release or policy tone is stronger than expected.
field_definitions.lower_meaning: Common interpretation when the release or policy tone is weaker than expected.
field_definitions.watch_points: Context items to compare together when interpreting the event.
field_definitions.related_indicators: Indicator keys that connect this event to existing indicator explanations.
field_definitions.display_text: UI-safe text bundle that mirrors the core explanation fields.
field_definitions.workflow_status: Marks this item as static calendar explanation metadata rather than runtime sentiment output.
field_definitions.analysis_hints: Static rule seeds for future workflows; not runtime predictions.
field_definitions.event_definition: Calendar-specific scheduling metadata used by collectors and API formatting.

recommended_frontend_usage: Use short_label on compact calendar chips and description/market_role/higher_meaning/lower_meaning/watch_points in event detail panels or tooltips.
recommended_backend_shape: Load this JSON once and expose the same explanation fields used by indicator metadata, while reading event_definition for scheduling, source mapping, and collector allowlist logic.
